line:
for i in $(seq 1 90); do
  out=$(ssh -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o BatchMode=yes me@example.com 'cd /root/lilly-logic && echo "$(tail -1 deploy/update/output.log 2>/dev/null | sed "s/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g" | cut -c1-70)|$(ls deploy/update/.updating 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d " ")"' 2>/dev/null)
  line=$(echo "$out" | cut -d'|' -f1); upd=$(echo "$out" | cut -d'|' -f2)
  echo "[$i] updating=$upd  $line"
  if [ "$upd" = "0" ]; then echo "UPDATE FINISHED"; break; fi
  sleep 20
done
